verdict.rationale: Adyen publishes an official, documented MCP server. It runs locally via `npx -y @adyen/mcp`, authenticates with a scoped API key, and exposes Checkout, payment-link, modification and Management API tools that an LLM client can connect to, and a probe confirms the docs page exists. missing for 10: production maturity (the server is labelled Alpha), a hosted/remote MCP endpoint (local stdio only), and independent hands-on corroboration of agent connections.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: Our Model Context Protocol (MCP) server lets you use natural language with your chosen Large Language Model (LLM) client.
contains a set of tools that lets you interact with the Adyen APIs for common use cases
To authenticate the requests you will make using the MCP, generate an API key.
